name: dsh-local-worktree
description: A one-click git worktree inside DSH: the button activates in a git workspace, creates an isolated worktree with local git only, and merges the worktree's commits back into the branch it came from — no remote, no GitHub. · 在 DSH 里一键用 git worktree 隔离开发，完成后一键把提交合并回原分支——全程本地，不碰 remote。

meta.title: Git Worktree
meta.description: One-click git worktree: isolate the work, then merge it back locally.
